title: Paris informant to Nevers, 29 April 1588 (BnF fr. 3976 fol. 62, DECODE R3705)

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3976 fol. 62 (piece 30); Gallica btv1b9060548h canvas 111; DECODE R3705
documents.route: unnamed informant at court (Paris) -> Louis de Gonzague, duc de Nevers

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf; sibling f. 131 (same informant, 4 June 1588) has interlinear decipherments of its own runs.

transcription.notes: 19 runs, 440 characters = 344 signs (one character, or '1'+character), counted with a python tokenizer; docs/_check_profile.py --measure counts runs or characters, not signs.

system.summary: Clear letter with inserted runs in a homophonic, partly polyphonic letter-and-figure substitution (signs of one character or 1+character), plus bare code numbers for persons and places.

conditions.human_role: Target chosen by the user from the catalogue; no hand help.

solution.what: Gallica ark of fr. 3976 (btv1b9060548h) found in gallica_sweep; f. 62 = canvas 111 by pencil foliation; BnF notice gives piece 30, 29 April 1588, letter with cipher, no decipherment.
First transcription of the 19 cipher runs from full-resolution crops (runs_first_pass.txt).
Tomokiyo Nevers keys nos. 16, 11, 10, 18 and the alphabet on fr. 3995 canvas 45 applied to run R01: no French.
Ciphertext-only homophonic anneals (solve.py, solve2.py, solve3.py; letter, null-i and i-as-space variants, unigram penalty, 8 restarts of 200k steps): e/n/t collapse, no French.
Symbol ciphers of ff. 56 and 60 (with decipherments) checked: different system.
f. 131 (4 June 1588, same hand) has interlinear decipherments; aligning 'conte de Brissac' and 'quelques mutins d'entr'eux' showed signs are one character or 1+character and gave ~15 values.
Runs read one by one with the partial key and clear context (Villeroy, Bellievre, du royaume, leur entreprise a failly, chancellier et d'O, ligueurs), extending the key each time.
Second zoomed pass: z read as 2, curly d as 8, g as 9 in several runs; readings re-derived.
All 19 runs read as French in context; 350/353 plaintext letters read (reading.tsv), name in R01 and one word in R18 tentative.

outcome.fraction_read_source: nevers1588/reading.tsv, plaintext letters with ? counted as unread
